evals.prompt: Use the todo-conventions skill: rewrite this as a todo item for the ToDo app: "I should probably remember to buy some milk on the way home today."
evals.expected_output: A short imperative item without filler, at most 60 characters, sentence case, no trailing period.
expectations: The item starts with an imperative verb such as Buy
The item is 60 characters or fewer
The item has no filler words like 'probably' or 'I should'
The item does not end with a period

evals.prompt: Use the todo-conventions skill: I want my ToDo app's todos to survive a page reload. Show me the code change for index.html.
evals.expected_output: Persistence added with localStorage under the key todo:v1, storing the todos array as JSON, wrapped in try/catch.
expectations: Uses localStorage with the key todo:v1
Stores the todos array as JSON
Wraps storage reads and writes in try/catch
Keeps the change inside index.html without adding a framework or extra files

evals.prompt: Use the todo-conventions skill: please rename the element ids todo-form, todo-input and todo-list in the ToDo app to form, input and items.
evals.expected_output: Declines to rename the three ids because tooling depends on them, and suggests a class or wrapper element instead.
expectations: Does not rename todo-form, todo-input or todo-list
Explains that tests or tooling look those ids up
Suggests a class or wrapper element as the alternative

evals.prompt: Use the todo-conventions skill: add this as a todo item: "Schedule a meeting with the whole platform team to discuss the quarterly infrastructure migration plan and budget"
evals.expected_output: The item is shortened to 60 characters or fewer, the cut is mentioned, and it starts with an imperative verb.
expectations: The resulting item is 60 characters or fewer
The item starts with an imperative verb
The response says the text was shortened
